title: KOSPI Close November 24, 2026: Rises 6.32% to 5,006.03, KOSDAQ +4.79%
content:
KOSPI closed at 5,006.03, up 6.32%, back above 5,000, and KOSDAQ closed at 665.88, up 4.79%, as a surge in U.S. chip stocks brought foreign and institutional buying. Buy sidecars were reported on both markets, and chips, robots, Hyundai Motor Group names and battery stocks all rose.

KOSPI5,006.03+6.32%

1. Sharp rebound on U.S. chip rally

KOSPI opened at 4,880.16 (+3.65%) and rose as high as 5,065.74 (+7.59%) before closing at 5,006.03. KOSDAQ opened at 654.31 (+2.97%), reached 670.95 (+5.59%) and closed at 665.88. The previous session KOSPI had fallen 3.31% to 4,708.54.

Korean market coverage attributed the rebound to reports of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang returning to management, which eased uncertainty around the AI industry; it said the Nasdaq rose 6.51% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index 14.03%. Dip buying and short covering after the recent plunge added to the move. These points come from market coverage and were not independently confirmed.

On KOSPI, institutions net bought about 871 billion won and foreigners about 732 billion won, while individuals net sold about 2.05 trillion won (provisional). On KOSDAQ, institutions net bought about 212 billion won and foreigners about 114 billion won, while individuals net sold about 310 billion won.

2. Chips — large caps and equipment makers

Samsung Electronics and SK hynix led the index higher as hopes for AI data center and high-performance chip demand revived, and buying spread to substrate and front-end and back-end equipment makers.

3. Robots — Samsung humanoid plan

Robot stocks rose on reports that Samsung Electronics plans to unveil its own humanoid robot at CES 2027 in January. KH Vatec hit the upper limit on hopes that the precision metal processing it built up making foldable phone hinges could extend to robot parts. Quick FAQ

How did KOSPI and KOSDAQ close on Nov 24?
KOSPI closed at 5,006.03 (+6.32%), back above 5,000, and KOSDAQ at 665.88 (+4.79%).

Why did Korean stocks rebound?
A reported surge in U.S. tech and chip stocks, foreign and institutional buying, and dip buying and short covering after the recent plunge.

Which stocks hit the upper limit?
KH Vatec, Hyulim Robot, Korea PIM, Hyundai AutoEver and Mobase Electronics closed near +30%.
